entities.summary: Marc Uwizeye, commonly known as Rocky Kimomo (; born August 24, 1991 in Kigali, Rwanda, to Gerrard Nzamurambaho and Immaculée Batamuliza, is a Rwandan recording artist,songwriter, sculptor, dubbing artist, and film producer.
